title: Lasers and Laser-Related Equipment - Test Methods for Laser Beam Parameters - Beam Positional Stability
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14819) covers Lasers and Laser-Related Equipment - Test Methods for Laser Beam Parameters - Beam Positional Stability. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 1 1670 : 1999 'Lasers and laser-related equipment — Test methods for laser beam parameters — Beam positional stability' issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the the Optical and Mathematical Instruments Sectional Committee and approval of the Mechanical Engineering Division Council. Lasers are now increasingly used for various industrial, medical and defence applications. The technical committee, therefore, felt the need to develop Indian Standard on the subject for safe deployment of laser systems. The text of ISO Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
